# Yale Medicine

> Yale Medicine provides comprehensive clinical care, research, and patient education across specialized departments, conditions, and clinical trials.

Yale Medicine is an academic medical center offering expert care in multiple specialties including oncology, rheumatology, gastroenterology, and pulmonology. The site serves as a resource for patients seeking information about health conditions, clinical trials, and medical departments.

## Key Topics

- Clinical Trials
- Medical Conditions
- Patient Education
- Departments & Specialties
- Yale Cancer Center
- Smilow Cancer Hospital
- Rheumatology
- Gastroenterology
- Oncology
- Cardiology
- Pulmonology
- Health Conditions Directory
- Medical Glossary
- Healthcare Services
- Specialty Centers

## Clinical Resources & Departments

- [Departments & Collaborative Centers](https://www.yalemedicine.org/departments): Yale Medicine departments, centers, and clinical specialties overview
- [Condition Topics](https://www.yalemedicine.org/conditions): Directory of health conditions and medical topics organized by specialty
- [Clinical Keywords](https://www.yalemedicine.org/clinical-keywords): Searchable medical glossary with clinical terms and Yale Medicine resources

## Clinical Trials

- [Search Clinical Trials](https://www.yalemedicine.org/clinical-trials): Searchable database of 668+ clinical trials at Yale Medicine facilities

## Patient Education & Health Topics

- [News & Updates](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news): Yale Medicine news hub covering research, patient stories, and health updates
- [GLP-1 Medications for Weight Loss: How to Get Started](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/glp-1-medications-for-weight-loss-how-to-get-started): Expert guide on GLP-1 medications like Wegovy and Zepbound for weight loss
- [What Does the 'New' Definition of Obesity Mean to You?](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/what-does-the-new-definition-of-obesity-mean-to-you): Cardiologist explains new obesity definition and BMI/BRI health risk assessment
- [Could Your Back Pain Be From Axial Spondyloarthritis?](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/could-your-back-pain-be-from-axial-spondyloarthritis): Axial spondyloarthritis screening tool and diagnosis information from Yale Medicine
- [Why Gastrointestinal Problems Often Affect Women Differently](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/why-gastrointestinal-problems-often-affect-women-differently): Expert analysis of gender differences in GI disorders and IBS/IBD symptoms
- [Still Using the Same Rescue Inhaler for Asthma? You Might Have Better Options](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/still-using-the-same-rescue-inhaler-for-asthma-you-might-have-better-options): Yale Medicine asthma specialists discuss modern inhaler treatment options
- [How Exercises After Knee Replacement Surgery Can Speed Your Recovery](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/how-exercises-after-knee-replacement-surgery-can-speed-your-recovery): Post-surgery exercise guide for knee replacement recovery by Yale Medicine expert
- [Laryngitis: Why You Lose Your Voice and What Helps](https://www.yalemedicine.org/news/laryngitis-why-you-lose-your-voice-and-what-helps): Medical explanation of laryngitis causes, symptoms, and treatment options
